stats2data

We introduce the stats2data package: Nonparametric Data Simulation from Reported Summary Statistics.

Usage

The method is available as R package and comprehensive ShinyApp.

Web App

You can use the app at https://sebastian-lortz.shinyapps.io/stats2data/. Expect longer computation time compared to running the app locally.

Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

   install.packages("stats2data")

Run

You can launch the ShinyApp locally by running:

stats2data::run_app()

Citation

Please cite stats2data if you use it. To cite the software, use:

Lortz SAJ (2026). stats2data: Nonparametric Data Simulation from Reported Summary Statistics. R package version 0.1.0, https://github.com/sebastian-lortz/stats2data.

Or copy the reference information to your BibTeX file:

@Manual{,
  title = {stats2data: Nonparametric Data Simulation from Reported Summary Statistics},
  author = {Sebastian A. J. Lortz},
  year = {2026},
  note = {R package version 0.1.0},
  url = {https://github.com/sebastian-lortz/stats2data},
}
